remarks: PRIME WINDSOR PARK LOCATION, STEPS FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF ALBERTA! Excellent investment opportunity on a massive 17.4 m x 45.7 m lot (approx. 8,560 sq ft) in one of Edmonton's most desirable neighbourhoods! This well-maintained bungalow offers 8 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms. The main floor features 5 bedrooms, a kitchen and a 3-piece bath. The fully finished basement includes a 3-bedroom with a second kitchen, laundry room, and both 3-piece and 4-piece bathrooms. Numerous upgrades include newer shingles, furnace, tankless hot water heater, windows, bathrooms and doors. A 25 kW solar power system helps offset electricity costs and generates credits for excess power returned to the grid. Enjoy a huge, fully fenced backyard and TWO DETACHED GARAGES, offering exceptional parking and outdoor space. Ideally located near the U of A, University Hospital, Windsor Park School, river valley, LRT and amenities. (id:67522)
